notes: New tool: Column Section. Rectangle, square or circle columns with the outer tie and inner ties drawn as real ASD bars, with counts, descriptions, dimensions and a column mark, checked against ECP 203.
Beam Section and Column Section: INSERT IN DRAWING now hides the window and lets you pick the point in the drawing directly.
Circular columns use ASD's own circular tie with proper hooks. New white ribbon icons for Beam and Column Section.
